name: open-seo-mcp-skills
title_zh: 只认你自家 Search Console 数据的 S
tagline_zh: 不靠猜，不靠第三方爬虫——直接接你 GA4/广告账户的真实数据做关键词、排名、外链、竞品缺口分析。
tagline_en: No guessing, no third-party crawlers—plug into your real GA4/ads data for keywords, rankings, backlinks.
desc_en: Open-source SEO + GEO skills for Claude — keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks, competitor gaps, AI visibility. Runs on your real Search Console / GA4 / ads data via MCP, with DataForSEO built in. Free, MIT.
why_zh: 机制上拒绝“模拟数据”，所有结论都从你已验证的 MCP 数据管道流出；DataForSEO 内置。
why_en: Refuses simulated data by design—every insight flows from your authenticated MCP pipelines; DataForSEO is bundled but defaults.
limit_zh: 必须已有 Search Console / GA4 / 广告账户的 MCP 服务并配好凭证；只覆盖这些数据源能见到的域。
limit_en: Requires pre-configured MCP servers for Search Console/GA4/ads with credentials; covers only domains visible in those sources, no social or off-site.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: SEO audit deck that trusts only your Search Console data
